keywords: EIP-8250/8272 改写为对 8141 的增量
操作码与 TXPARAM 冲突
summary: soispoke 提交一组 frame 交易家族整理 PR：EIP-8141 用 `charged_gas` 统一 frame gas、EIP-3529 退款与 EIP-7623 下限并用于费用结算；EIP-8250 与 EIP-8272 改写为只描述对 8141 的增量修改，并解决与 8141 冲突的 TXPARAM 和操作码分配。kassandraETH 用自制 CLI 在主网测试 Tornado Cash、Railgun 和 Privacy Pools 存取。

items.topic: frame 交易家族的 gas 记账与结构整理
items.title: EIP-8141：费用结算采用 charged_gas
items.note: （soispoke）提交。此前 8141 定义了 frame gas 上限、交易级 EIP-3529 退款和 EIP-7623 calldata 下限，但没有一致地连起来，`charged_gas` 还引用 `total_gas_used`，费用结算沿用旧 `tx_fee` 模型且未与付款方的最大费用托管对账。PR 从按序 frame 收据计算未用 gas，先退款再取下限得到 `charged_gas`，用于区块 gas 计数和收据 `cumulative_gas_used`，执行前预留 `tx_gas_limit` 并把差额退回区块 gas 池。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: apply charged_gas to fee settlement
items.note_en: (soispoke), submitted. 8141 defined frame gas limits, a transaction-level EIP-3529 refund and the EIP-7623 calldata floor but did not connect them consistently: `charged_gas` still referenced `total_gas_used`, and fee settlement used the older `tx_fee` model without reconciling the payer's maximum fee escrow. The PR computes unused gas from the ordered frame receipts, applies the refund before the floor to get `charged_gas`, uses it for block gas accounting and receipt `cumulative_gas_used`, reserves `tx_gas_limit` before execution and returns the difference to the block gas pool.
items.topic_en: Gas accounting and structure in the frame transaction family

items.topic: frame 交易家族的 gas 记账与结构整理
items.title: EIP-8250：交易自省分配对齐
items.note: （soispoke）提交并合并：8250 把 `TXPARAM_NONCE_KEY_0` 分配为 `0x0B`，而 8141 已把它给了 `len(signatures)`，现移到 `0x10`，并按 8141 当前的 `payer` 与原子批次模型改写 nonce 消耗和回滚措辞。
items.note_en: (soispoke), submitted and merged: 8250 assigned `TXPARAM_NONCE_KEY_0` to `0x0B`, which 8141 already uses for `len(signatures)`, so it moves to `0x10`, and nonce consumption and rollback wording follows 8141's current `payer` and atomic batch model.
items.topic_en: Gas accounting and structure in the frame transaction family

items.topic: frame 交易家族的 gas 记账与结构整理
items.title: EIP-8272：解决 RECENTROOTREFLOAD 操作码冲突
items.note: 提交，`0xB4` 已被 8141 的 `SIGPARAM` 占用，移至 `0xB5`。EIP-8250：keyed nonce 改为增量修改 与 EIP-8272：recent root 改为增量修改 提交，使两者只表达为对 8141 的修改。EIP-8141：澄清解码、签名与激活 提交，定义 payload 的 RLP 形状，对 P256 签名应用 EIP-7951 验证规则。
items.title_en: EIP-8272: resolve the RECENTROOTREFLOAD opcode collision
items.note_en: Submitted, moving it from `0xB4`, already 8141's `SIGPARAM`, to `0xB5`. EIP-8250: make keyed nonce changes additive and EIP-8272: make recent root changes additive, submitted, so both are expressed only as changes to 8141. EIP-8141: clarify decoding, signing and activation, submitted, defining the payload's RLP shape and applying EIP-7951 validation rules to P256 signatures.

summary_en: soispoke submitted a set of cleanup PRs for the frame transaction family: EIP-8141 uses `charged_gas` to tie together frame gas, the EIP-3529 refund and the EIP-7623 floor and applies it to fee settlement; EIP-8250 and EIP-8272 are rewritten to describe only their changes to 8141, and their TXPARAM and opcode assignments that collided with 8141 are resolved. kassandraETH tested Tornado Cash, Railgun and Privacy Pools deposits and withdrawals on mainnet with a homegrown CLI.
